# Empirical inputs

This report reads the empirical outputs produced by `empirical_database.Rmd`.
It does not read the original saved summary metrics from the legacy workflow.

```{r load-empirical-inputs}
empirical_MNS_file <- file.path(empirical_result_dir, "empirical_MNS.rds")
empirical_metrics_file <- file.path(empirical_result_dir, "empirical_metrics.rds")
if (!file.exists(empirical_MNS_file) || !file.exists(empirical_metrics_file)) {
  stop("Run empirical_database.Rmd first. Missing empirical MNS or metrics output.")
}
empirical_MNS <- readRDS(empirical_MNS_file)
empirical_metrics <- readRDS(empirical_metrics_file)
if (!"diameter" %in% names(empirical_metrics)) {
  stop("Run empirical_database.Rmd again. Missing metric: diameter")
}
```

## Sampled joint-MNS networks

The dependence among `(M,N,S)` is estimated with a three-dimensional Gaussian
copula fitted by maximum pseudo-likelihood. Type-1 empirical quantiles retain
the three observed marginal distributions.

```{r fit-copula-and-simulate}
MNS_copula_model <- fit_MNS_copula(empirical_MNS)
copula_parameter_table <- data.frame(
  Parameter = names(MNS_copula_model$coefficients),
  Estimate = as.numeric(MNS_copula_model$coefficients)
)
knitr::kable(
  copula_parameter_table,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Fitted Gaussian-copula dependence parameters"
)
write.csv(
  copula_parameter_table,
  file.path(result_dir, "copula_MNS_parameters.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

simulation_file <- file.path(result_dir, "copula_MNS_rewiring_300.rds")
if (file.exists(simulation_file)) {
  simulation <- readRDS(simulation_file)
}
if (!exists("simulation") || is.null(simulation$simulation_schema_version) ||
    simulation$simulation_schema_version < 3L) {
  simulation <- simulate_copula_MNS_rewiring(
    copula_model = MNS_copula_model,
    n_qualified = 300L,
    allocation_attempts_per_MNS = 10L,
    max_rewiring_attempts = 50L,
    seed = 123L
  )
  saveRDS(simulation, simulation_file)
}
stopifnot(length(simulation$networks) == 300L)
write.csv(
  simulation$summary,
  file.path(result_dir, "copula_MNS_sampled_parameters.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# Failure summary

We obtained `r simulation$n_qualified` qualified null-model networks after
sampling `r simulation$MNS_attempts` joint parameter tuples $(M,N,S)$.
`r simulation$rejected_MNS_attempts` tuples did not produce a qualified
network: `r simulation$rejection_summary$count[simulation$rejection_summary$reason == "structurally_infeasible_MNS"]`
were structurally infeasible before allocation, and
`r simulation$rejection_summary$count[simulation$rejection_summary$reason == "generation_attempts_exhausted"]`
were feasible tuples that still failed after all allocation and rewiring
attempts.

The simulation does **not** explicitly impose $M \geq 2$ or $N \geq 4$ as
rejection rules. Instead, both requirements are automatically satisfied by
the empirical margins used after the copula draw: the observed minimum is
$M=2$ and the observed minimum is $N=4$. Because the sampler uses type-1
empirical quantiles, it cannot generate values below those minima. The table
below reports how often these conditions and the edge-count conditions
occurred among all sampled tuples and among rejected tuples. Conditions can
overlap, so the rows must not be added.

For the tuples that passed the structural check, the algorithm sampled
`r simulation$allocation_attempts_total` initial edge allocations on its way
to the final 300 networks. Before any repair, these allocations experienced
the defects shown in the second table. These counts are also non-exclusive:
one allocation can be both disconnected and have low trial or treatment
degree. The $S<2M$ count is zero at the allocation stage because such a tuple
is rejected before an allocation is attempted; its total occurrence is shown
in the tuple-condition table.

All final networks are checked again after rewiring. Therefore, the third
table directly answers how many of the 300 qualified networks are
disconnected or violate either degree constraint.

```{r failure-summary}
failure_overview <- data.frame(
  Quantity = c(
    "Qualified networks",
    "Joint (M,N,S) tuples sampled",
    "Tuples not producing a qualified network",
    "Structurally infeasible tuples",
    "Feasible tuples exhausting generation attempts"
  ),
  Count = c(
    simulation$n_qualified,
    simulation$MNS_attempts,
    simulation$rejected_MNS_attempts,
    simulation$rejection_summary$count[
      simulation$rejection_summary$reason == "structurally_infeasible_MNS"
    ],
    simulation$rejection_summary$count[
      simulation$rejection_summary$reason == "generation_attempts_exhausted"
    ]
  )
)
knitr::kable(failure_overview, caption = "Overall generation outcome")

tuple_condition_labels <- c(
  M_lt_2 = "M < 2 (excluded automatically by empirical margin)",
  N_lt_4 = "N < 4 (excluded automatically by empirical margin)",
  S_lt_2M = "S < 2M",
  S_lt_N = "S < N",
  S_lt_M_plus_N_minus_1 = "S < M + N - 1",
  S_gt_MN = "S > MN"
)
tuple_condition_table <- simulation$tuple_condition_summary |>
  mutate(
    Condition = unname(tuple_condition_labels[condition]),
    `All sampled tuples` = all_sampled_MNS,
    `Rejected tuples` = rejected_MNS
  ) |>
  select(Condition, `All sampled tuples`, `Rejected tuples`)
knitr::kable(
  tuple_condition_table,
  caption = "Conditions observed in sampled (M,N,S) tuples"
)

allocation_failure_table <- simulation$allocation_failure_summary |>
  mutate(
    Defect = recode(
      reason,
      disconnected = "Disconnected",
      S_lt_2M = "S < 2M",
      trial_degree_lt_2 = "At least one trial has degree < 2",
      treatment_degree_lt_1 = "At least one treatment has degree < 1"
    )
  ) |>
  select(Defect, Count = count)
knitr::kable(
  allocation_failure_table,
  caption = paste(
    "Defects observed across",
    simulation$allocation_attempts_total,
    "initial edge allocations"
  )
)

final_failure_table <- simulation$final_network_failure_summary |>
  mutate(
    Defect = recode(
      reason,
      disconnected = "Disconnected",
      S_lt_2M = "S < 2M",
      trial_degree_lt_2 = "At least one trial has degree < 2",
      treatment_degree_lt_1 = "At least one treatment has degree < 1"
    )
  ) |>
  select(Defect, Count = count)
knitr::kable(
  final_failure_table,
  caption = "Defects in the final 300 qualified networks"
)
```

## Failures requiring targeted rewiring by number of treatments

The plot below is restricted to networks that ultimately qualified. For each
number of treatments, it counts networks whose initial allocation failed at
least one qualification check and therefore required targeted rewiring
(`rewiring_attempts > 0`).

```{r rewiring-failures-by-treatments, fig.width=8, fig.height=4.5}
rewiring_failures_by_N <- simulation$summary |>
  group_by(N) |>
  summarise(
    failures_requiring_rewiring = sum(rewiring_attempts > 0L),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_rewiring_failures_by_N <- ggplot(
  rewiring_failures_by_N,
  aes(x = N, y = failures_requiring_rewiring)
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.85, fill = "grey60", colour = "grey15", linewidth = 0.25
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = pretty(range(rewiring_failures_by_N$N), n = 10)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = pretty(
      range(c(0, rewiring_failures_by_N$failures_requiring_rewiring)),
      n = 6
    ),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of treatments",
    y = "Number of initial failures requiring targeted rewiring"
  )

p_rewiring_failures_by_N

```

## Rewired edges by number of treatments: separate 10,000-network sample

This diagnostic uses a separate copula sample and continues until 10,000
qualified networks have been generated. A moved edge counts as one rewired
edge in the trial- or treatment-degree repair. A double-edge swap used to join
components counts as two rewired edges. The total is the sum across the three
repair targets. Initially valid networks are retained with zero rewired edges,
so each mean describes all qualified networks at that value of $N$.

```{r simulate-rewiring-effort}
rewiring_effort_file <- file.path(
  result_dir, "copula_MNS_rewiring_effort_10000.rds"
)
if (file.exists(rewiring_effort_file)) {
  rewiring_effort_simulation <- readRDS(rewiring_effort_file)
}
if (!exists("rewiring_effort_simulation") ||
    is.null(rewiring_effort_simulation$simulation_schema_version) ||
    rewiring_effort_simulation$simulation_schema_version < 1L ||
    rewiring_effort_simulation$n_qualified != 10000L) {
  rewiring_effort_simulation <- simulate_copula_MNS_rewiring_tracked(
    copula_model = MNS_copula_model,
    n_qualified = 10000L,
    allocation_attempts_per_MNS = 10L,
    max_rewiring_attempts = 50L,
    seed = 124L
  )
  saveRDS(rewiring_effort_simulation, rewiring_effort_file)
}
rewiring_effort_summary <- rewiring_effort_simulation$summary
stopifnot(
  length(rewiring_effort_simulation$networks) == 10000L,
  all(vapply(
    rewiring_effort_simulation$networks,
    is_valid_rewired_network,
    logical(1)
  )),
  all(
    rewiring_effort_summary$edges_rewired_total ==
      rewiring_effort_summary$edges_rewired_fix_trial +
      rewiring_effort_summary$edges_rewired_fix_treatment +
      rewiring_effort_summary$edges_rewired_fix_connected
  )
)
write.csv(
  rewiring_effort_summary,
  file.path(result_dir, "copula_MNS_rewiring_effort_10000_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r mean-rewired-edges-by-treatments, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
rewiring_target_labels <- c(
  edges_rewired_total = "Total",
  edges_rewired_fix_trial = "Fix trial degree",
  edges_rewired_fix_treatment = "Fix treatment degree",
  edges_rewired_fix_connected = "Connect components"
)

mean_rewired_edges_by_N <- rewiring_effort_summary |>
  select(N, all_of(names(rewiring_target_labels))) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -N,
    names_to = "rewiring_target",
    values_to = "edges_rewired"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    rewiring_target = factor(
      unname(rewiring_target_labels[rewiring_target]),
      levels = unname(rewiring_target_labels)
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(N, rewiring_target) |>
  summarise(
    mean_edges_rewired = mean(edges_rewired),
    qualified_networks = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv(
  mean_rewired_edges_by_N,
  file.path(result_dir, "mean_rewired_edges_by_treatments_10000.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

rewiring_target_colors <- c(
  "Total" = "grey15",
  "Fix trial degree" = "#0072B2",
  "Fix treatment degree" = "#D55E00",
  "Connect components" = "#009E73"
)
rewiring_target_linetypes <- c(
  "Total" = "solid",
  "Fix trial degree" = "dashed",
  "Fix treatment degree" = "dotdash",
  "Connect components" = "dotted"
)

p_mean_rewired_edges_by_N <- ggplot(
  mean_rewired_edges_by_N,
  aes(
    x = N, y = mean_edges_rewired,
    colour = rewiring_target, linetype = rewiring_target
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.75) +

  scale_colour_manual(values = rewiring_target_colors) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = pretty(range(mean_rewired_edges_by_N$N), n = 10)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = pretty(
      range(c(0, mean_rewired_edges_by_N$mean_edges_rewired)),
      n = 6
    ),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of treatments",
    y = "Mean number of rewired edges",
    colour = "Rewiring target",
    linetype = "Rewiring target"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal"
  )

p_mean_rewired_edges_by_N

```

For the proportional version, each network's rewired-edge count is divided by
its total number of bipartite edges, $S$, before averaging across qualified
networks with the same $N$. Thus, the denominator is the realised number of
trial--treatment edges in that network rather than the number of possible
edges, $MN$.

```{r mean-proportion-rewired-edges-by-treatments, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
mean_proportion_rewired_by_N <- rewiring_effort_summary |>
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(names(rewiring_target_labels)),
      ~ .x / S
    )
  ) |>
  select(N, all_of(names(rewiring_target_labels))) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -N,
    names_to = "rewiring_target",
    values_to = "proportion_rewired"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    rewiring_target = factor(
      unname(rewiring_target_labels[rewiring_target]),
      levels = unname(rewiring_target_labels)
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(N, rewiring_target) |>
  summarise(
    mean_proportion_rewired = mean(proportion_rewired),
    qualified_networks = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv(
  mean_proportion_rewired_by_N,
  file.path(
    result_dir,
    "mean_proportion_rewired_edges_by_treatments_10000.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

p_mean_proportion_rewired_by_N <- ggplot(
  mean_proportion_rewired_by_N,
  aes(
    x = N, y = mean_proportion_rewired,
    colour = rewiring_target, linetype = rewiring_target
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = rewiring_target_colors) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = rewiring_target_linetypes) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = pretty(range(mean_proportion_rewired_by_N$N), n = 10)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1),
    breaks = pretty(
      range(c(0, mean_proportion_rewired_by_N$mean_proportion_rewired)),
      n = 6
    ),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of treatments",
    y = paste(
      "Mean proportion of bipartite edges rewired",
      "among networks with the same N",
      sep = "\n"
    ),
    colour = "Rewiring target",
    linetype = "Rewiring target"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal"
  )

p_mean_proportion_rewired_by_N

```




# Verification check plots

`r empirical_legend_label` layers are orange and are drawn after the grey
`r simulated_legend_label` layers.

## Numbers of trials and treatments

```{r MN-comparison, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
MN_comparison <- bind_rows(
  simulation$summary |> transmute(M, N, Data = "Null Model"),
  empirical_MNS |> transmute(M, N, Data = "Database")
) |>
  mutate(Data = factor(Data, levels = names(comparison_colors)))

comparison_histogram <- function(variable, binwidth, boundary, x_label, title) {
  ggplot() +
    geom_histogram(
      data = filter(MN_comparison, Data == "Null Model"),
      aes(x = .data[[variable]], fill = Data),
      colour = "grey15", linewidth = 0.25,
      alpha = 0.9, binwidth = binwidth, boundary = boundary,
      position = "identity", show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_histogram(
      data = filter(MN_comparison, Data == "Database"),
      aes(x = .data[[variable]], fill = Data),
      colour = "grey15", linewidth = 0.25,
      alpha = 0.7, binwidth = binwidth, boundary = boundary,
      position = "identity", show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = comparison_colors, labels = comparison_labels) +
    labs(title = title, x = x_label, y = "Number of networks")
}

p_M_compare <- comparison_histogram(
  "M", 10, 0, "Number of trials", "(a)"
)
p_N_compare <- comparison_histogram(
  "N", 2, 4, "Number of treatments", "(b)"
)
p_MN_compare <- ggplot() +
  geom_count(
    data = filter(MN_comparison, Data == "Null Model"),
    aes(x = N, y = M, fill = Data, size = after_stat(n)),
    shape = 21, colour = "grey15", stroke = 0.35, alpha = 0.90
  ) +
  geom_count(
    data = filter(MN_comparison, Data == "Database"),
    aes(x = N, y = M, fill = Data, size = after_stat(n)),
    shape = 21, colour = "grey15", stroke = 0.35, alpha = 0.70
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = comparison_colors, labels = comparison_labels, name = "Data"
  ) +
  scale_size_area(
    max_size = 8, limits = c(1, 10), breaks = c(1, 2, 5, 10),
    name = "Count", guide = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE)
  ) +
  scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10(labels = plain_log_labels) +
  labs(title = "(c)", x = "Number of treatments", y = "Number of trials")

p_compare_MN <- p_M_compare + p_N_compare + p_MN_compare +
  plot_layout(nrow = 1, guides = "collect") &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box = "horizontal"
  )
p_compare_MN

```

}

# Compute sampled-network metrics

Metrics and degree vectors are computed here and saved for
`metrics comparison.Rmd`. The comparison report does not reopen or analyse the
network matrices.

```{r compute-null-results}
# This table includes the mean bipartite trial/treatment degrees and the mean
# weighted/unweighted unipartite degrees returned by metric_functions.R.
null_metrics <- compute_metrics_for_networks(simulation$networks)
mean_degree_columns <- c(
  "mean_bipartite_trial_degree",
  "mean_bipartite_treatment_degree",
  "mean_unipartite_weighted_degree",
  "mean_unipartite_unweighted_degree"
)
stopifnot(all(mean_degree_columns %in% names(null_metrics)))
degree_irregularity_columns <- c(
  "bi_trial_deg_irreg",
  "bi_treatment_deg_irreg"
)
stopifnot(all(degree_irregularity_columns %in% names(null_metrics)))
stopifnot("diameter" %in% names(null_metrics))
null_edge_multiplicity <- compute_edge_multiplicity_for_networks(
  simulation$networks
)

degree_rows <- lapply(seq_along(simulation$networks), function(i) {
  B <- simulation$networks[[i]]
  projection <- crossprod(B)
  diag(projection) <- 0
  graph <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(
    1L * (projection > 0), mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE
  )
  list(
    unipartite = data.frame(
      network_id = names(simulation$networks)[i],
      degree = as.integer(degree(graph))
    ),
    trial = data.frame(
      network_id = names(simulation$networks)[i],
      degree = as.integer(rowSums(B))
    ),
    treatment = data.frame(
      network_id = names(simulation$networks)[i],
      degree = as.integer(colSums(B))
    )
  )
})
null_degrees <- list(
  unipartite = bind_rows(lapply(degree_rows, `[[`, "unipartite")),
  trial = bind_rows(lapply(degree_rows, `[[`, "trial")),
  treatment = bind_rows(lapply(degree_rows, `[[`, "treatment"))
)
null_degrees$counts <- lapply(null_degrees, function(data) {
  data |> filter(degree > 0) |> count(degree, name = "count")
})

# Maximum-likelihood fit for the shifted geometric trial-degree distribution
# P(K = k) = (1 - theta) * theta^(k - k_min), k >= k_min.
null_trial_vector <- null_degrees$trial$degree
null_trial_vector <- null_trial_vector[
  is.finite(null_trial_vector) & null_trial_vector > 0
]
null_trial_k_min <- min(null_trial_vector)
null_trial_excess <- null_trial_vector - null_trial_k_min
null_trial_theta <-
  sum(null_trial_excess) /
  (length(null_trial_excess) + sum(null_trial_excess))
null_trial_geometric_fit <- list(
  theta = null_trial_theta,
  k_min = null_trial_k_min,
  n = length(null_trial_vector),
  line = data.frame(
    degree = seq.int(null_trial_k_min, max(null_trial_vector))
  ) |>
    mutate(
      count = length(null_trial_vector) *
        (1 - null_trial_theta) *
        null_trial_theta^(degree - null_trial_k_min)
    )
)

saveRDS(null_metrics, file.path(result_dir, "null_metrics.rds"))
saveRDS(
  null_edge_multiplicity,
  file.path(result_dir, "null_edge_multiplicity.rds")
)
saveRDS(null_degrees, file.path(result_dir, "null_degrees.rds"))
saveRDS(
  null_trial_geometric_fit,
  file.path(result_dir, "null_trial_geometric_fit.rds")
)
saveRDS(simulation$summary, file.path(result_dir, "null_MNS.rds"))
write.csv(null_metrics, file.path(result_dir, "null_metrics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(
  null_edge_multiplicity,
  file.path(result_dir, "null_edge_multiplicity.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(simulation$summary, file.path(result_dir, "null_MNS.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(null_degrees$counts$unipartite, file.path(result_dir, "degree_unipartite.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(null_degrees$counts$trial, file.path(result_dir, "degree_bipartite_trial.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(null_degrees$counts$treatment, file.path(result_dir, "degree_bipartite_treatment.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(
  data.frame(
    theta = null_trial_geometric_fit$theta,
    k_min = null_trial_geometric_fit$k_min,
    n = null_trial_geometric_fit$n
  ),
  file.path(result_dir, "null_trial_geometric_fit.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("Sampled networks with saved metrics:", nrow(null_metrics), "\n")
```

## Fitted-line parameters for the comparison report

The regression parameters are prepared here so the comparison report can load
the saved table directly.

```{r save-fitted-line-parameters}
fit_input <- bind_rows(
  null_metrics |> mutate(Data = "Null Model"),
  empirical_metrics |> mutate(Data = "Database")
)

fit_specs <- tribble(
  ~Metric, ~Network, ~variable, ~label, ~bipartite, ~log_y,
  "Density", "Unipartite", "density", "Network density (Unipartite)", FALSE, TRUE,
  "Density", "Bipartite", "bi_density", "Network density (Bipartite)", TRUE, TRUE,
  "Average path length", "Unipartite", "avg_path_length", "Average path length (Unipartite)", FALSE, FALSE,
  "Average path length", "Bipartite", "bi_apl", "Average path length (Bipartite)", TRUE, FALSE,
  "Diameter", "Unipartite", "diameter", "Diameter (Unipartite)", FALSE, FALSE,
  "Clustering coefficient", "Unipartite", "unipartite_c", "Clustering coefficient (Unipartite)", FALSE, FALSE,
  "Clustering coefficient", "Bipartite", "bipartite_c", "Clustering coefficient (Bipartite)", TRUE, FALSE,
  "Degree assortativity", "Unipartite", "assortativity", "Degree assortativity (Unipartite)", FALSE, FALSE,
  "Degree assortativity", "Bipartite", "bi_assortativity", "Bipartite degree assortativity (trial-treatment)", TRUE, FALSE,
  "Degree irregularity", "Unipartite", "deg_irreg", "Degree irregularity (Unipartite)", FALSE, TRUE,
  "Trial-degree irregularity", "Bipartite", "bi_trial_deg_irreg", "Trial-degree irregularity (Bipartite)", TRUE, TRUE,
  "Treatment-degree irregularity", "Bipartite", "bi_treatment_deg_irreg", "Treatment-degree irregularity (Bipartite)", TRUE, TRUE
)

fit_one_line <- function(specification, predictor, x_axis) {
  model_data <- fit_input |>
    filter(
      is.finite(.data[[specification$variable]]),
      is.finite(.data[[predictor]]),
      .data[[predictor]] > 0
    )
  if (specification$log_y) {
    model_data <- model_data |> filter(.data[[specification$variable]] > 0)
  }
  model_data |>
    group_by(Data) |>
    group_modify(function(data, key) {
      x_fit <- log10(data[[predictor]])
      y_fit <- if (specification$log_y) {
        log10(data[[specification$variable]])
      } else {
        data[[specification$variable]]
      }
      model <- lm(y_fit ~ x_fit)
      tibble(
        Metric = specification$Metric,
        Network = specification$Network,
        `X-axis` = x_axis,
        `Y-axis` = if (specification$log_y) {
          paste0("log10(", specification$label, ")")
        } else specification$label,
        Slope = unname(coef(model)[2]),
        Intercept = unname(coef(model)[1]),
        `R-squared` = summary(model)$r.squared
      )
    }) |>
    ungroup()
}

fit_rows <- list()
fit_index <- 0L
for (i in seq_len(nrow(fit_specs))) {
  predictors <- if (fit_specs$bipartite[i]) {
    c(N = "N_treatments", M = "N_total_trials")
  } else c(N = "N_treatments")
  for (x_axis in names(predictors)) {
    fit_index <- fit_index + 1L
    fit_rows[[fit_index]] <- fit_one_line(
      fit_specs[i, ], predictors[[x_axis]], x_axis
    )
  }
}

fitted_line_parameters <- bind_rows(fit_rows) |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Metric, Network, `X-axis`, `Y-axis`),
    names_from = Data,
    values_from = c(Slope, Intercept, `R-squared`),
    names_glue = "{Data} { .value}"
  ) |>
  select(
    Metric, Network, `X-axis`, `Y-axis`,
    `Database Slope`, `Database Intercept`, `Database R-squared`,
    `Null Model Slope`, `Null Model Intercept`, `Null Model R-squared`
  )

saveRDS(
  fitted_line_parameters,
  file.path(result_dir, "fitted_line_parameters.rds")
)
write.csv(
  fitted_line_parameters,
  file.path(result_dir, "fitted_line_parameters.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
